title: RefinementGuard: Counterexample-Directed Semantic Qualification for Hidden Agent-Tool Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.23611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool runtimes can lower an agent-selected operation into a hidden parallel graph, reducing latency and context while risking semantic mistranslation. We introduce RefinementGuard: translation validation for hidden, effectful agent-tool lowerings, coupled to artifact-bound, fail-closed runtime admission. Qualification compares a candidate graph with an independent reference on isolated state using explicit parent-operation obligations. We evaluate two repository-level contracts, bug localization and patch validation, on controlled repositories. Among 100 activated, non-equivalent development/qualification faults adjudicated by one human, parent-semantic validation rejects 49/100 (operator-cluster bootstrap 95% CI [33.7%, 64.8%]). translated_title: RefinementGuard：面向隐藏智能体-工具执行的反例导向语义资格验证
translated_abstract: 工具运行时可以将智能体选择的操作下沉到隐藏的并行图中，在降低延迟与上下文开销的同时，也带来了语义误译的风险。我们提出RefinementGuard：一种针对隐藏的、有副作用的智能体-工具下沉过程的翻译验证方法，并与工件绑定的、故障关闭式运行时准入机制相耦合。资格验证利用显式的父操作义务，在隔离状态下将候选图与独立参考进行比较。我们在受控仓库上评估了两个仓库级契约：缺陷定位与补丁验证。在由一名人工裁判裁定的100个已激活的非等价开发/资格验证故障中，父语义验证拒绝了49/100（算子聚类自助法95%置信区间[33.7%, 64.8%]）。其目标是选择性准入，而非最大化的变异拒绝：精确相等验证虽能拒绝100/100的故障，但也会拒绝全部60个有效变体；而基于义务的验证则接受了60/60的有效变体，其剩余的51个误接受……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RefinementGuard框架，通过反例导向的语义资格验证（基于显式父操作义务，将候选图与独立参考在隔离状态下比对）结合工件绑定的故障关闭式运行时准入，来守护智能体工具调用下沉至隐藏并行图的过程，在保留全部有效变体的同时拒绝近半数非等价故障。
en_tdlr: RefinementGuard introduces counterexample-directed translation validation for hidden, effectful agent-tool lowerings—comparing candidate graphs against an independent reference via explicit parent-operation obligations—coupled with fail-closed runtime admission to selectively reject non-equivalent faults while accepting all valid variants.
